```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r cars}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
# Read your data (replace with your actual file paths)
up_regulated <- read.csv("GO_enrichment/p1_UP_genes_GO_enrichment.csv", header = TRUE)
down_regulated <- read.csv("GO_enrichment/p1_DOWN_genes_GO_enrichment.csv", header = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Add regulation direction column
up_regulated$Regulation <- "Up-regulated"
down_regulated$Regulation <- "Down-regulated"

# Combine datasets
combined_data <- rbind(up_regulated, down_regulated)

# Select top GO terms (e.g., top 10 by Fisher p-value for each regulation)
top_terms <- combined_data %>%
  group_by(Regulation) %>%
  arrange(Fisher) %>%
  #slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# Create the barplot
p <- ggplot(top_terms, aes(x = reorder(Term, prop.sig.genes), 
                           y = prop.sig.genes, 
                           fill = Regulation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Up-regulated" = "#D55E00", 
                                "Down-regulated" = "#0072B2")) +
  labs(x = "GO Term", 
       y = "Proportion of Significant Genes",
       title = "Enriched GO Terms in Up- and Down-regulated Genes",
       fill = "Regulation") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

# Display the plot
print(p)
```

```{r}
# Optional: facet by ontology
p2 <- ggplot(top_terms, aes(x = reorder(Term, prop.sig.genes), 
                            y = prop.sig.genes, 
                            fill = Regulation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ontology, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Up-regulated" = "#D55E00", 
                                "Down-regulated" = "#0072B2")) +
  labs(x = "GO Term", 
       y = "Proportion of Significant Genes",
       title = "Enriched GO Terms by Ontology Category",
       fill = "Regulation") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(p2)
```


```{r}
# Prepare data for mirrored barplot
top_terms_mirror <- top_terms %>%
  mutate(prop.sig.genes = ifelse(Regulation == "Down-regulated", 
                                  -prop.sig.genes, 
                                  prop.sig.genes))

# Create mirrored barplot
p4 <- ggplot(top_terms_mirror, aes(x = reorder(Term, abs(prop.sig.genes)), 
                                    y = prop.sig.genes, 
                                    fill = Regulation)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Up-regulated" = "#D55E00", 
                                "Down-regulated" = "#0072B2")) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = abs) +
  labs(
    x = "GO Terms",
    y = "Proportion of sig. enriched GO terms",
    title = "Phase 1 GO term enrichment patterns",
    fill = "Regulation"
  )

print(p4)
```

```{r}
# Save the plot
ggsave("phase1_GO_enrichment_mirror.png", plot = p4, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```
